SELECT g.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_device_group_item dgi WHERE dgi.group_id = g.id) AS device_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_device_group_item dgi JOIN sp_device d ON d.id = dgi.device_id WHERE dgi.group_id = g.id AND d.is_deleted != '1' AND d.status = '0') AS idle_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_device_group_item dgi JOIN sp_device d ON d.id = dgi.device_id WHERE dgi.group_id = g.id AND d.is_deleted != '1' AND d.status = '1') AS running_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_device_group_item dgi JOIN sp_device d ON d.id = dgi.device_id WHERE dgi.group_id = g.id AND d.is_deleted != '1' AND d.status = '2') AS repair_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sp_device_group_item dgi JOIN sp_device d ON d.id = dgi.device_id WHERE dgi.group_id = g.id AND d.is_deleted != '1' AND d.status = '3') AS scrap_count FROM sp_device_group g WHERE g.is_deleted != '1'
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND g.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
